UFC Fight Night: Hernandez vs. Rodrigues arrives in Sacramento, California, on August 22, 2026, marking the UFC’s return to the city after more than seven years. The event takes place at Golden 1 Center and is headlined by a high-stakes middleweight showdown between local favorite Anthony “Fluffy” Hernandez and Brazilian knockout artist Gregory “Robocop” Rodrigues. Hernandez enters the fight determined to bounce back after suffering a TKO loss to Sean Strickland earlier this year, a defeat that snapped an impressive eight-fight winning streak. Fighting close to home, “Fluffy” has a major opportunity to re-establish himself among the UFC’s middleweight contenders and prove that the setback was only a temporary obstacle. His recent training camp included working alongside Strickland in Las Vegas, with Hernandez focused on making significant improvements to his game. Standing across the Octagon is Gregory Rodrigues, one of the division’s most dangerous power punchers. “Robocop” has built strong momentum, winning six of his last seven fights according to pre-event coverage, including three consecutive victories and two first-round knockout performances that earned Performance of the Night bonuses. His combination of explosive striking, physicality, and experience makes him a serious threat to Hernandez over five rounds. The stakes are high for both fighters. Hernandez is looking to reclaim his momentum and strengthen his position in the middleweight rankings, while Rodrigues has the chance to make another major statement against a ranked opponent. Both fighters successfully made weight, with Hernandez coming in at 186 pounds and Rodrigues at 185 pounds, officially setting the stage for the five-round main event. The UFC Sacramento card also features a strong co-main event between heavyweight contenders Serghei Spivac and Vitor Petrino, along with Reinier de Ridder vs. Roman Dolidze at light heavyweight and several other intriguing matchups. The full event is scheduled to stream on Paramount+ in the United States, with the main card beginning at 8 p.m. ET. With Sacramento welcoming the UFC back to the city, the spotlight is firmly on Anthony “Fluffy” Hernandez and Gregory “Robocop” Rodrigues. Hernandez has the home crowd behind him and something to prove, while Rodrigues brings dangerous knockout power and winning momentum. Everything is set for an intense middleweight battle and one of the most anticipated UFC Fight Night main events of the summer. #UFC #MMA #HernandezVsRodrigues #UFCFightNight #LIVE
